verses: Allah aur uss kay rasool ki janib say beyzaari ka ailaan hai. Unn mushrikon kay baray mein jin say tum ney ehad o-paymaan kiya tha
Pus (aey mushriko!) tum mulk mein char maheeney tak to chal phir lo, jaan lo kay tum Allah ko aajiz kerney walay nahi ho, aur yeh (bhi yaad rahey) kay Allah kafiron ko ruswa kerney wala hai

Allah aur uss kay rasool ki taraf say logon ko baray hajj kay din saaf itlaa hai kay Allah mushrikon say beyzaar hai, aur uss ka rasool bhi, agar abb bhi tum tauba ker lo to tumharay haq mein behtar hai, aur agar tum roo-gardani kero to jaan lo kay tum Allah ko hara nahi saktay. Aur kafiron ko dukh aur maar ki khabar phoncha dijiye

Ba-juz unn mushrikon kay jin say tumhara mohaeeda ho chuka hai aur unhon ney tumhen zara sa bhi nuksan nahi phonchaya na kissi ki tumharay khilaf madad ki hai to tum bhi unn kay mohaeeday ki muddat unn kay sath poori kero, Allah Taalaa perhezgaron ko dost rakhta hai

Phir hurmat walay maheenon kay guzartay hi mushrikon ko jahan pao qatal kero unhen giriftar kero, unn ka mahasra kerlo aur unn ki taaq mein her ghaati mein jaa betho, haan agar woh tauba kerlen aur namaz kay paband ho jayen aur zakat ada kerney lagen tum unn ki raahen chor do. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai

Agar mushrikon mein say koi tujh say panah talab keray to to ussay panah dey dey yahan tak kay woh kalaam Allah sunn ley phir ussay apni jaye aman tak phoncha dey. Yeh uss liye kay yeh log bey ilm hain

Mushrikon kay liye ehad Allah aur uss kay rasool kay nazdeek kaisay reh sakta hai siwaye unn kay jin say tum ney ehad o-paymaan masjid haram kay pass kiya hai, jab tak woh log tum say mohaeeda nibhayen tum bhi unn say daari kero, Allah Taalaa muttaqiyon say mohabbat rakhta hai

Unn kay wadon ka kiya aitbaar unn ka agar tum per ghalba ho jaye to na yeh qarabat daari ka khayal keren na ehad-o-paymaan ka, apni zabano say to tumhen parcha rahey hain lekin unn kay dil nahi mantay unn mein say aksar to fasiq hain
Unhon ney Allah ki aayaton ko boht kum qeemat per baich diya aur uss ki raah say roka. Boht bura hai jo yeh ker rahey hain
Yeh to kissi musalman kay haq mein kissi rishtedari ka ya ehad ka mutlaq lehaz nahi kertay, yeh hain hi hadd say guzarney walay
Abb bhi agar yeh tauba ker len aur namaz kay paband ho jayen aur zakat detay rahen to tumharay deeni bhai hain. Hum to jannay walon kay liye apni aayaten khol khol ker biyan ker rahey hain

Agar yeh log ehad-o-paymaan kay baad bhi apni qasmon ko tor den aur tumharay deen mein taana zani keren to tum bhi unn sardaraan-e-kufur kufur say bhirr jao. Unn ki qasmen koi cheez nahi, mumkin hai kay uss tarah woh bhi baaz aajayen

Tum unn logon ki sirkoobi kay liye kiyon tayyar nahi hotay jinhon ney apni qasmon ko tor diya aur payghumbar ko jila watan kerney ki fikar mein hain aur khud hi awwal baar unhon ney tum say cher ki hai, kiya tum unn say dartay ho? Allah hi ziyadah mustahiq hai kay tum uss ka darr rakho ba-shart-e-kay tum eman walay ho
Unn say tum jang kero Allah Taalaa unhen tumharay hathon azab dey ga, unhen zaleel o ruswa keray ga, tumhen unn per madad dey ga aur musalmanon kay kalejay thanday keray ga
Aur unn kay dil ka ghum o ghussa door keray ga, aur woh jiss ki taraf chahata hai rehmat say tawajja farmata hai. Allah janta boojhta hikmat wala hai

Kiya tum yeh samajh bethay ho kay tum chor diye jao gay halankay abb tak Allah ney tum mein say unhen mumtaz nahi kiya jo mujahid hain aur jinhon ney Allah kay aur uss kay rasool kay aur mominon kay siwa kissi ko dili dost nahi banaya. Allah khoob khabardaar hai jo tum ker rahey ho
Laeeq nahi kay mushrik Allah Taalaa ki masjidon ko abad keren. Daran halanakay woh khud apney kufur kay aap hi gawah hain, unn kay aemaal ghaarat o ikaarat hain, aur woh daeemi tor per jahannumi hain

Allah ki masjidon ki ronaq o aabadi to unn kay hissay mein hai jo Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhtay hun, namazon kay paband hun, zakat detay hun, Allah kay siwa kissi say na dartay hun, tawaqqa hai kay yehi log yaqeenan hidayat yafta hain

Kiya tum ney hajiyon ko pani pila dena aur masjid haram ki khidmat kerna uss kay barabar ker diya hai jo Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per eman laye aur Allah ki raah mein jihad kiya, yeh Allah kay nazdeek barabar kay nahi aur Allah Taalaa zalimon ko hidayat nahi deta
Jo log eman laye, hijrat ki, Allah ki raah mein apney maal aur apni jaan say jihad kiya woh Allah kay haan boht baray martaba walay hain, aur yehi log murad paney walay hain
Unhen unn ka rab khushkhabri deta hai apni rehmat ki aur razamandi ki aur jannaton ki, unn kay liye o haan dawami nemat hai
O haan yeh hamesha rehney walay hain Allah kay pass yaqeenan boht baray sawab hain
Aey eman walo! apney baapon ko aur apney bhaiyon ko dost na banao agar woh kufur ko eman say ziyadah aziz rakhen. Tum mein say jo bhi unn say mohabbat rakhay ga woh poora gunehgar zalim hai

Aap keh dijiye kay agar tumharay baap aur tumharay larkay tumharay bhai aur tumhari biwiyan aur tumharay kunbay qabeelay aur tumharay kamaye huye maal aur woh tijarat jiss ki kami say tum dartay ho aur woh hawayliyan jinhen tum pasand kertay ho agar yeh tumhen Allah say aur uss kay rasool say aur uss ki raah mein jihad say bhi ziyadah aziz hain, to tum intizar kero kay Allah Taalaa apna azab ley aaye. Allah Taalaa fasiqon ko hidayat nahi deta

Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ney boht say maidanon mein tumhen fatah di hai aur hunain ki laraee walay din bhi jab kay tumhen apni kasrat per naaz hogaya tha, lekin uss ney tumhen koi faeedah na diya balkay)yeh zamin bawajood apni kushadgi kay tum per tang hogaee phir tum peeth pher ker murr gaye
Phir Allah ney apni taraf ki taskeen apney nabi per aur mominon per utari aur apney woh lashkar bhejay jinhen tum dekh nahi rahey thay aur kafiron ko poori saza di. Unn kuffaar ka yehi badla tha
Phir uss kay baad bhi jiss per chahaye Allah Taalaa apni rehmat ki tawajja farmaye ga Allah hi bakhsish o meharbani kerney wala hai

Aey eman walo! bey shak mushrik bilkul hi pak hain woh uss saal kay baad masjid haram kay pass bhi na phatakney payen agar tumhen muflisi ka khof hai to Allah tumhen dolat mand ker dey ga apney fazal say agar chahaye Allah ilm o hikmat wala hai

Unn logon say laro, jo Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman nahi latay jo Allah aur uss kay rasool ki haram kerdah shey ko haram nahi jantay, na deen haq ko qabool kertay hain unn logon mein jinhen kitab di gaee hai, yahan tak kay woh zaleel o khuwar ho ker apney hath say jizya ada keren

Yahud kehtay hain uzair Allah ka beta hai aur nasrani kehtay hain maseeh Allah ka beta hai yeh qol sirf unn kay mun ki baat hai. Aglay munkiron ki baat ki yeh bhi naqal kerney lagay Allah unhen ghaarat keray woh kaisay paltaye jatay hain

Unn logon ney Allah ko chor ker apney aalimon aur darwishon ko rab banaya hai aur Maryam kay betay maseeh ko halankay unhen sirf aik akelay Allah hi ki ibadat ka hukum diya gaya tha jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi woh pak hai unn kay shareek muqarrar kerney say
Woh chahatay hain kay Allah kay noor ko apney mun say bujha den aur Allah Taalaa inkari hai magar ussi baat ka kay apna noor poora keray go kafir na khush rahen
Ussi ney apney rasool ko hidayat aur sachay deen kay sath bheja hai kay ussay aur tamam mazhabon per ghalib ker dey agar cheh mushrik bura manen

Aey eman walo! aksar ulama aur abid, logon ka maal na-haq kha jatay hain aur Allah ki raah say rok detay hain aur jo log soney chandi ka khazana rakhtay hain aur Allah ki raah mein kharach nahi kertay, unhen dard-naak azab ki khabar phoncha dijiye

Jiss din uss khazaney ko aatish dozakh mein tapaya jaye ga phir uss say unn ki payshaniyan aur pehloo aur peethen daaghi jayen gi (unn say kaha jaye ga) yeh hai jissay tum ney apney liye khazana bana ker rakha tha. Pus apney khazanon ka maza chakho

Maheenon ki ginti Allah kay nazdeek kitab Allah mein baara ki hai, ussi din say jab say aasman o zamin ko uss ney peda kiya hai uss mein say char hurmat o adab kay hain. Yehi durust deen hai, tum unn maheenon mein apni janon per zulm na kero aur tum tamam mushrikon say jihad kero jaisay kay woh tum sab say lartay hain aur jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa muttaqiyon kay sath hai

Maheenon ka aagay peechay ker dena kufur ki ziyadti hai uss say woh log gumrahi mein dalay jatay hain jo kafir hain. Aik saal to ussay halal ker letay hain aur aik saal ussi ko hurmat wala ker letay hain, kay Allah ney jo hurmat rakhi hai uss kay shumar mein to moafiqat ker len phir ussay halal bana len jissay Allah ney haram kiya hai unhen unn kay buray kaam bhalay dikha gaye hain aur qom kuffaar ki Allah rehnumaee nahi farmata

Aey eman walo! tumhen kiya ho gaya hai kay jab tum say kaha jata hai kay chalo Allah kay raastay mein kooch kero to tum zamin say lagay jatay ho. Kiya tum aakhirat kay ewaz duniya ki zindagani per hi reejh gaye ho. Suno! duniya ki zindagi to aakhirat kay muqablay mein kuch yunhi si hai

Agar tum ney kooch na kiya to tumhen Allah Taalaa dard-naak saza dey ga aur tumharay siwa aur logon ko badal laye ga, tum Allah Taalaa ko koi nuksan nahi phoncha saktay aur Allah her cheez per qadir hai

Agar tum unn (nabi salla Allah alaihi wasallam) ki madad na kero to Allah hi ney unn ki madad ki uss waqt jabkay unhen kafiron ney (dess say) nikal diya tha, do mein say doosra jabkay woh dono ghaar mein thay jab yeh apney sathi say keh rahey thay kay ghum na ker Allah humaray sath hai, pus janab bari ney apni taraf say taskeen uss per nazil farma ker unn lashkaron say uss ki madad ki jinhen tum ney dekha hi nahi, uss ney kafiron ki baat pust ker di aur buland o aziz to Allah ka kalma hi hai, Allah ghalib hai hikmat wala hai
Nikal kharay ho jao halkay phulkay ho to bhi aur bhari bhar kum ho to bhi, aur raah rab mein apni maal o jaan say jihad kero, yehi tumharay liye behtar hai agar tum mein ilm ho

Agar jald wasool honey wala maal o asbaab hota aur halka safar hota to yeh zaroor aap kay peechay ho letay lekin unn per to doori aur daraz ki mushkil parr gaee. Abb to yeh Allah ki qasmen khayen gay kay agar hum mein qooat o taqat hoti to hum yaqeenan aap kay sath nikaltay, yeh apni janon ko khud hi halakat mein daal rahey hain unn kay jhoota honey ka sacha ilm Allah ko hai
Allah tujhay moaf farma dey, tu ney unhen kiyon ijazat dey di? Baghair uss kay kay teray samney sachay log khul jayen aur to jhootay logon ko bhi jaan ley

Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman o yaqeen rakhney walay to maali aur jaani jihad say ruk rehney ki kabhi bhi tujh say ijazat talab nahi keren gay, aur Allah Taalaa perhezgaron ko khoob janta hai
Yeh ijazat to tujh say o hi talab kertay hain jinhen na Allah per eman hai na aakhirat kay din ka yaqeen hai jin kay dil shak mein paray huye hain aur woh apney shak mein hi sir-gardan hain

Agar unn ka iradah jihad kay liye nikalney ka hota to woh uss safar kay liye saman ki tayyari ker rakhtay lekin Allah ko unn ka uthna pasand hi na tha uss liye unhen harkat say hi rok diya aur keh diya gaya kay tum bethney walon kay sath bethay hi raho

Agar yeh tum mein mill ker nikaltay bhi to tumharay liye siwaye fasad kay aur koi cheez na barhatay balkay)yeh tumharay darmiyan khoob ghoray dora detay aur tum mein fitney dalney ki talash mein rehtay unn kay mannay walay khud tum mein mojood hain, aur Allah unn zalimon ko khoob janta hai

Yeh to uss say pehlay bhi fitney ki talash kertay rahey hain aur teray liye kaamon ko ulat palat kertay rahey hain, yahan tak kay haq phoncha aur Allah ka hukum ghalib aagaya bawajood woh khushi mein hi rahey
Unn mein say koi to kehta hai mujhay ijazat dijiye mujhay fitney mein na daliye, aagah raho woh to fitney mein parr chukay hain aur yaqeenan dozakh kafiron ko gher lenay wali hai

Aap ko agar koi bhalaee mill jaye to unhen bura lagta hai aur koi buraee phonch jaye to yeh kehtay hain hum ney to apna moamla pehlay say hi durust ker liya tha, phir to baray hi itratay huye lottay hain

Aap keh dijiye kay humen siwaye Allah kay humaray haq mein likhay huye kay koi cheez phonch hi nahi sakti woh humara kaar saaz aur maula hai. Mominon ko to Allah ki zaat pak per hi bharosa kerna chahaiye.

Keh dijiye kay tum humaray baray mein jiss cheez ka intizar ker rahey ho woh do bhalaiyon mein say aik hai aur hum tumharay haq mein uss ka intizar kertay hain kay ya to Allah Taalaa apney pass say koi saza tumhen dey ya humaray hathon say, pus aik taraf tum muntazir raho doosri janib tumharay sath hum bhi muntazir hain
Keh dijiye kay tum khushi khushi kissi tarah bhi kharach kero qabool to hergiz na kiya jaye ga, yaqeenan tum fasiq log ho

Koi sabab unn kay kharach ki qabooliyat kay na honey ka uss kay siwa nahi kay yeh Allah aur uss kay rasool kay munkir hain aur bari kaahili say hi namaz ko aatay hain aur buray dil say hi kharach kertay hain
Pus aap ko unn kay maal o aulad tajjub mein na daal den. Allah ki chahat yehi hai kay uss say unhen duniya ki zindagi mein hi saza dey aur unn kay kufur hi ki halat mein unn ki janen nikal jayen
Yeh Allah ki qasam kha kha ker kehtay hain kay yeh tumhari jamat kay log hain, halankay woh dar-asal tumharay nahi baat sirf itni hai kay yeh darpok log hain
Agar yeh koi bachao ki jagah ya koi ghaar ya koi bhi sir ghusaney ki jagah paalen to abhi uss tarah lagam tor ker ultay bhaag chooten
Unn mein woh bhi hain jo kheyraati maal ki taqseem kay baray mein aap per aib rakhtay hain, agar unhen uss mein say mill jaye to khush hain aur agar uss mein say na mila to foran bigar kharay huye

Agar yeh log Allah aur rasool kay diye huye per khush rehtay aur keh detay kay Allah humen kafi hai Allah humen apney fazal say dey ga aur uss ka rasool bhi, hum to Allah ki zaat say hi tawaqqa rakhney walay hain

Sadqay sirf faqeeron kay liye hain aur miskeenon kay liye aur unn kay wasool kerney walon kay liye aur unn kay liye jin kay dil parchaye jatay hun aur gardan churaney mein aur qarz daron kay liye aur Allah ki raah mein aur raah musafiron kay liye, farz hai Allah ki taraf say, aur Allah ilm o hikmat wala hai

Unn mein say woh bhi hain jo payghumbar ko ezza detay hain aur kehtay hain kaan ka kacha hai, aap keh dijiye kay woh kaan tumharay bhalay kay liye hai woh Allah per eman rakhta hai aur musalmanon ki baat ka yaqeen kerta hai aur tum mein say jo ahl eman hain yeh unn kay liye rehmat hai, rasool Allah) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (ko jo log ezza detay hain unn kay liye dukh ki maar hai
Mehaz tumhen khush kerney kay liye tumharay samney Allah ki qasmen kha jatay hain halankay agar yeh eman daar hotay to Allah aur uss ka rasool mand kerney kay ziyadah mustahiq thay
Kiya yeh nahi jantay kay jo bhi Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat keray ga uss kay liye yaqeenan dozakh ki aag hai jiss mein woh hamesha rehney wala hai, yeh zabardast ruswaee hai

Munafiqon ko her waqt uss baat ka khutka rehta hai kay kahen musalmanon per koi surat na utray jo unn kay dilon ki baaten unhen batla dey. Keh dijiye kay tum mazaq uratay raho. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ussay zahir kerney wala hai jiss say tum darr dubak rahey ho
Agar aap unn say poochen to saaf keh den gay kay hum to yunhi aapas mein hans bol rahey thay. Keh dijiye kay Allah, uss ki aayaten aur uss ka rasool hi tumharay hansi mazaq kay liye reh gaye hain?
Tum bahaney na banao yaqeenan tum apney eman kay baad bey eman hogaye, agar hum tum mein say kuch logon say darguzar bhi ker len to kuch logon ko unn kay jurum ki sangeen saza bhi den gay

Tamam munafiq mard o aurat aapas mein aik hi hain, yeh buri baaton ka hukum detay hain aur bhali baaton say roktay hain aur apni muthi band rakhtay hain, yeh Allah ko bhool gaye Allah ney unhen bhala diya. Be-shak munafiq hi fasiq fasiq-o-ba-dkirdar hain

Allah Taalaa unn munafiq mardon, aurton kafiron say jahannum ki aag ka wada ker chuka hai jahan yeh hamesha rehney walay hain, o hi unhen kafi hai unn per Allah ki phitkaar hai, aur unn hi kay liye daeemi azab hai

Misil unn logon kay jo tum say pehlay thay, tum mein say woh ziyadah qooat walay thay aur ziyadah maal o aulad walay thay pus woh apna deeni hissa barat gaye phir tum ney bhi apna hissa barat liya jaisay tum say pehlay kay log apney hissay say faeedah mand huye thay aur tum ney bhi ussi tarah mazaqan behas ki jaisay kay unhon ney ki thi. Unn kay aemaal duniya aur aakhirat mein ghaarat hogaye. Yehi log nuksan paney walay hain

Kiya unhen apney say pehlay logon ki khabren nahi phonchin, qom Nooh aur aad aur samood aur qom Ibrahim aur ahl madiyan aur ahl ehal-e-motafiqaat (ulti hui bastiyon kay rehney walay) ki, unn kay pass unn kay payghumbar daleelen ley ker phonchay, Allah aisa na tha kay unn per zulm keray balkay)yeh unhon ney khud hi apney upper zulm kiya

Momin mard o aurat aapas mein aik doosray kay (madadgar o moawin aur) dost hain, woh bhalaiyon ka hukum detay hain aur buraiyon say roktay hain, namazon ko pabandi say baja latay hain zakat ada kertay hain, Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki baat mantay hain, yehi log hain jin per Allah Taalaa boht jald reham farmaye ga be-shak Allah ghalbay wala hikmat wala hai

Unn eman daar mardon aur aurton say Allah ney unn jannaton ka wada farmaya hai jin kay neechay nehren lehren ley rahi hain jahan woh hamesha hamesha rehney walay hain aur unn saaf suthray pakeezah mehallaat ka jo unn hameshgi wali jannaton mein hain, aur Allah ki razamandi sab say bari cheez hai, yehi zabardast kaamyabi hai
Aey nabi! kafiron aur munafiqon say jihad jari rakho, aur unn per sakht ho jao unn ki asli jagah dozakh hai, jo nihayat bad-tareen jagah hai

Yeh Allah ki qasmen kha ker kehtay hain kay unhon ney nahi kaha, halankay yaqeenan kufur ka kalma unn ki zaban say nikal chuka hai aur yeh apney islam kay baad kafir hogaye hain aur unhon ney uss kaam ka qasad bhi kiya jo poora na ker sakay. Yeh sirf ussi baat ka intiqam ley rahey hain kay unhen Allah ney apney fazal say aur uss kay rasool) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (ney dolat mand kerdiya, agar yeh abb bhi tauba ker len to yeh unn kay haq mein behtar hai, aur agar mun moray rahen to Allah Taalaa unhen duniya o aakhirat mein dard-naak azab dey ga aur zamin bhar mein unn ka koi himayati aur madadgar na khara hoga
Unn mein woh bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say ehad kiya tha kay agar woh humen apney fazal say maal dey ga to hum zaroor sadqa o kheyraat keren gay aur pakki tarah neko kaaron mein ho jayen gay
Lekin jab Allah ney apney fazal say unhen diya to yeh uss mein bakheeli kerney lagay aur taal matol kerkay mun mor liya
Pus uss ki saza mein Allah ney unn kay dilon mein nifaq daal diya Allah say milney kay dino tak, kyunkay unhon ney Allah say kiye huye waday ka khilaf kiya aur kiyon kay jhoot boltay rahey
Kiya woh nahi jantay kay Allah Taalaa ko unn kay dil ka bhed aur unn ki sirgoshi sab maloom hai aur Allah Taalaa ghaib ki tamam baaton say khabardaar hai

Log unn musalmanon per taana zani kertay hain jo dil khol ker kheyraat kertay hain aur unn logon per jinhen siwaye apni mehnat mazdoori kay aur kuch mayassar hi nahi, pus yeh unn ka mazaq uratay hain, Allah bhi unn say tamaskhur kerta hai unhi kay liye dard-naak azab hai

Unn kay liye to istaghfaar ker ya na ker. Agar to satter martaba bhi unn kay liye istaghfaar keray to bhi Allah unhen hergiz na bakhshay ga yeh uss liye kay unhon ney Allah say aur uss kay rasool say kufur kiya aisay fasiq logon ko rab karim hidayat nahi deta

Peechay reh janey walay log rasool Allah) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (kay janey kay baad apney bethay rehney per khush hain unhon ney Allah ki raah mein apney maal aur apni janon say jihad kerna pasand rakha aur unhon ney keh diya kay uss garmi mein mat niklo. Keh dijiye kay dozakh ki aag boht hi sakht garum hai, kaash kay woh samajhtay hotay
Pus unhen chahaiye kay boht kum hansen aur boht ziyadah royen badlay mein uss kay jo yeh kertay thay

Pus agar Allah Taalaa aap ko unn ki kissi jamat ki taraf lota ker wapis ley aaye phir yeh aap say maidan jang mein nikalney ki ijazat talab keren to aap keh dijiye kay tum meray sath hergiz chal nahi saktay aur na meray sath tum dushmanon say laraee ker saktay ho. Tum ney pehli martaba hi beth rehney ko pasand kiya tha pus tum peechay reh janey walon mein hi bethay raho

Unn mein say koi marr jaye to aap uss kay janazay ki hergiz namaz na parhen aur na uss ki qabar per kharay hun. Yeh Allah aur uss kay rasool kay munkir hain aur martay dum tak badkaar bey ita’at rahey hain
Aap ko unn kay maal o aulad kuch bhi bhalay na lagen! Allah ki chahat yehi hai kay unhen unn cheezon say dunyawi saza dey aur yeh apni janen nikalney tak kafir hi rahen

Jab koi surat utari jati hai to Allah per eman lao aur uss kay rasool kay sath mill ker jihad kero to unn mein say dolat mandon ka aik tabqay aap kay pass aaker yeh keh ker rukhsat ley leta kay humen to bethay rehney walon mein hi chor dijiye
Yeh to khana nasheen aurton sath denay per reejh gaye aur unn kay dilon per mehar laga di gaee abb woh kuch samajh aqal nahi rakhtay
Lekin khud rasool Allah aur uss kay sath kay eman walay apney maalon aur janon say jihad kertay hain, yehi log bhalaiyon walay hain aur yehi log kaamyabi hasil kerney walay hain
Unhi kay liye Allah ney woh jannaten tayyar ki hain jin kay neechay nehren jari hain jin mein yeh hamesha rehney walay hain. Yehi boht bari kaamyabi hai

Badiya nasheenon mein say uzur walay log hazir huye kay unhen rukhsat dey di jaye aur woh beth rahey jinhon ney Allah say aur uss kay rasool say jhooti baaten banaee thin. Abb to unn mein jitney kuffaar hain unhen dukh denay wali maar phonch ker rahey gi

Zaeefon per aur beemaron per aur unn per jin kay pass kharach kerney ko kuch bhi nahi koi haraj nahi ba-shart-e-kay woh Allah aur uss kay rasool ki khair khuwahi kertay rahen. Aisay nek kaaron per ilzam ki koi raah nahi, Allah Taalaa bari maghfirat o rehmat wala hai

Haan unn per bhi koi haraj nahi jo aap kay pass aatay hain kay aap unhen sawari mohiyya ker den to aap jawab detay hain kay mein to tumhari sawari kay liye kuch bhi nahi pata, to woh ranj o ghum say apni aankhon say aansoo bahatay huye lot jatay hain kay unhen kharach kerney kay liye kuch bhi mayassar nahi

Be-shak unhen logon per raah ilzam hai jo bawajood daulatmand honey kay aap say ijazat talab kertay hain. Yeh khana nasheen aurton ka sath denay per khush hain aur unn kay dilon per mehar mohar-e-khudawandi lag chuki hai jiss say woh mehaz bey ilm ho gaye hain

Yeh log tumharay samney uzur paish keren gay jab tum unn kay pass wapis jao gay. Aap keh dijiye kay yeh uzur paish mat kero hum kabhi tum ko sacha na samjhen gay, Allah Taalaa hum ko tumhari khabar dey chuka hai aur aaeenda bhi Allah aur uss ka rasool tumhari guzari dekh len gay phir aisay kay pass lotaye jao gay jo posheedah aur zahir sab ka jannay wala hai phir woh tum ko bata ga jo kuch tum kertay thay

Haan woh abb tumharay samney Allah ki qasmen kha jayen gay jab tum unn kay pass wapis jao gay takay tum unn ko unn ki halat per chor do. So tum unn ko unn ki halat per chor do. Woh log bilkul ganday hain aur unn ka thikana dozakh hai unn kaamon kay badlay jinhen woh kiya kertay thay
Yeh uss liye qasmen khayen gay kay tum unn say razi hojao. So agar tum unn say razi bhi hojao to Allah Taalaa to aisay fasiq logon say razi nahi hota

Dehaati log kufur aur nifaq mein boht hi sakht hain aur unn ko aisa hona hi chahaiye kay unn ko unn ehkaam ka ilm na ho jo Allah Taalaa ney apney rasool per nazil farmaye hain aur Allah bara ilm wala bari hikmat wala hai

Aur unn dehatiyon mein say baaz aisay hain kay jo kuch kharach kertay hain uss ko jurmana samajhtay hain aur tum musalmanon kay wastay buray waqt kay muntazir rehtay hain, bura waqt unn hi per parney wala hai aur Allah sunnay wala jannay wala hai

Aur baaz ahl ehal-e-dehaat mein aisay bhi hain jo Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhtay hain aur jo kuch kharach kertay hain uss ko indallah qurb hasil honey ka zariye aur rasool ki dua ka zariye banatay hain, yaad rakho kay unn ka yeh kharach kerna be-shak unn kay liye mojib-e-ghaiz qurbat hai, unn ko Allah Taalaa zaroor apni rehmat mein dakhil keray ga. Allah Taalaa bari maghfirat wala bari rehmat wala hai

Aur jo mohajreen aur ansaar sabiq aur muqaddam hain aur jitney log ikhlaas kay sath unn kay pairo hain Allah unn sab say razi hua aur woh sab uss say razi huye aur Allah ney unn kay liye aisay baagh mohiyya ker rakhay hain jin kay neechay nehren jari hun gi jin mein hamesha rahen gay yeh bari kaamyabi hai

Aur kuch tumharay gird-o-paish walon mein aur kuch madinay walon mein aisay munafiq hain kay nifaq per aray huye hain, aap unn ko nahi jantay, unn ko hum jantay hain hum unn ko dohri saza den gay, phir woh baray bhari azab ki taraf bhejay jayen gay

Aur kuch aur log hain jo apni khata kay iqrari hain jinhon ney milay julay amal kiye thay, kuch bhalay aur kuch buray. Allah say umeed hai kay unn ki tauba qabool farmaye. Bila-shuba Allah Taalaa bari maghfirat wala bari rehmat wala hai

Aap unn kay maalon mein say sadqa ley lijiye, jiss kay zariye say aap unn ko pak saaf ker den aur unn kay liye dua kijiye, bila-shuba aap ki dua unn kay liye mojib-e-ghaiz itminan hai aur Allah Taalaa khoob sunta hai khoob janta hai
Kiya unn ko yeh khabar nahi kay Allah hi apney bandon ki tauba qabool kerta hai aur o hi sadqaat ko qabool farmata hai aur yeh kay Allah hi tauba qabool kerney mein aur rehmat kerney mein kamil hai

Keh dijiye kay tum amal kiye jao tumharay amal Allah khud dekh ley ga aur uss ka rasool aur eman walay (bhi dekh len gay) aur zaroor tum ko aisay kay pass jana hai jo tamam chupi aur khulli cheezon ka jannay wala hai. So woh tum ko tumhara sab kiya hua batla dey ga
Aur kuch aur log hain jin ka moamla Allah kay hukum aaney tak mulatawee hai unn ko saza dey ga ya unn ki tauba qabool kerley ga, aur Allah khoob jannay wala hai bara hikmat wala hai

Aur baaz aisay hain jinhon ney unn aghraaz kay liye masjid banaee hai kay zarar phonchayen aur kufur ki baaten keren aur daron mein tafareeq dalen aur uss shakhs kay qayam ka saman keren jo uss say pehlay say Allah aur rasool ka mukhalif hai, aur qasmen kha jayen gay kay ba-juz bhalaee kay aur humari kuch niyat nahi, aur Allah gawah hai kay woh bilkul jhootay hain

Aap uss mein kabhi kharay na hun. Albatta jiss masjid ki bunyaad awwal din say taqwa per rakhi gaee hai woh uss laeeq hai kay aap uss mein kharay hun, uss mein aisay aadmi hain kay woh khoob pak honey ko pasand kertay hain, aur Allah Taalaa khoob pak honey walon ko pasand kerta hai

Phir aaya aisa shakhs behtar hai jiss ney apni emaarat ki bunyaad Allah say darney per aur Allah ki khushnoodi per rakhi ho, ya woh shakhs, kay jiss ney apni emaarat ki bunyaad kissi ghaati kay kinaray per jo kay girney hi ko ho, rakhi ho, phir woh uss ko ley ker aatish dozakh mein gir paray, aur Allah Taalaa aisay zalimon ko samajh hi nahi deta

Unn ki yeh emaarat jo unhon ney banaee hai hamesha unn kay dilon mein shak ki bunyaad per (kaanta bann ker) khutakti rahey gi, haan magar unn kay dil hi agar paash paash hojayen to khair, aur Allah Taalaa bara ilm wala bari hikmat wala hai

Bila-shuba Allah Taalaa ney musalmanon say unn ki janon ko aur unn kay maalon ko uss baat kay ewaz mein khareed liya hai kay unn ko jannat milay gi. Woh log Allah ki raah mein lartay hain jiss mein qatal kertay hain aur qatal kiye jatay hain, uss per sacha wada kiya gaya hai Taurat mein aur Injeel mein aur Quran mein aur Allah say ziyadah apney ehad ko kaun poora kerney wala hai, to tum log apni uss bey per jiss ka tum ney moamla thehraya hai khushi manao, aur yeh bari kaamyabi hai

Woh aisay hain jo tauba kerney walay, ibadat kerney walay, hamd kerney walay, roza rakhney walay, (ya raah haq mein safar kerney walay) rukoo aur sajdah kerney walay, nek baaton ki taleem kerney walay aur buri baaton say baaz rakhney walay aur Allah ki haddon ka khayal rakhney walay hain aur aisay momineen ko aap khushkhabri suna dijiye
Payghumbar ko aur doosray musalmanon ko jaeez nahi kay mushrikeen kay liye maghfirat ki dua maangen agarcheh woh rishtedar hi hun uss amar kay zahir hojaney kay baad kay yeh log dozakhi hain

Aur Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka apney baap kay liye duaa-e maghfirat maangna woh sirf wada kay sabab say tha jo unhon ney uss say wada kerliya tha. Phir jab unn per yeh baat zahir hogaee kay woh Allah ka dushman hai to woh uss say mehaz bey talluq hogaye, waqaee Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) baray naram dil aur burd baar thay
Aur Allah aisa nahi kerta kay kissi qom ko hidayat ker kay baad mein gumrah ker dey jab tak kay unn cheezon ko saaf saaf na batla jin say woh bachen be-shak Allah Taalaa her cheez ko khoob janta hai
Bila-shuba Allah hi ki saltanat hai aasmano aur zamin mein. O hi jilata aur maarta hai, aur tumhara Allah kay siwa na koi yaar hai aur na koi madad gaar hai

Allah Taalaa ney payghumbar kay haal per tawajja farmaee aur mohajreen aur ansaar kay haal per bhi jinhon ney aisi tangi kay waqt payghumbar ka sath diya, uss kay baad kay unn mein say aik giroh kay dilon mein kuch tazalzul ho chala tha. Phir Allah ney unn kay haal per tawajja farmaee. Bila-shuba Allah Taalaa unn sab per boht hi shafiq meharban hai

Aur teen shakhson kay haal per bhi jin ka moamla mulatawee chor diya gaya tha. Yahan tak kay jab zamin bawajood apni farakhi kay unn per tang honey lagi aur woh khud apni jaan say tang aagaye aur unhon ney samajh liya kay Allah say kahen panah nahi mill sakti ba-juz uss kay kay ussi ki taraf rujoo kiya jaye phir unn kay haal per tawajja farmaee takay woh aaeenda bhi tauba saken. Be-shak Allah Taalaa boht tauba qabool kerney wala bara reham wala hai
Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa say daro aur sachon kay sath raho

Madina kay rehney walon ko aur jo dehaati unn kay gird-o-paish hain unn ko yeh zaiba na tha kay rasool Allah ko chor ker peechay reh jayen aur na yeh kay apni jaan ko unn ki jaan say aziz samjhen, yeh uss sabab say kay unn ko Allah ki raah mein jo piyas lagi aur jo thakaan phonchi aur jo bhook lagi aur jo kissi aisi jagah chalay jo kuffaar kay liye mojib-e-ghaiz ghaiz hua ho aur dushmanon ki jo kuch khabar li, unn sab per unn kay naam (aik aik) nek kaam likha gaya. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa mukhliseen ka ajar zaya nahi kerta
Aur jo kuch chota bara unhon ney kharach kiya aur jitney maidan unn ko tey kerney paray, yeh sab bhi unn kay naam likha gaya takay Allah Taalaa unn kay kaamon ka achay say acha badla dey

Aur musalmanon ko yeh na chahaiye kay sab kay sab nikal kharay hun so aisa kiyon na kiya jaye kay unn ki her bari jamat mein say aik choti jamat jaya keray takay woh deen ki samajh bojh hasil keren aur takay yeh log apni qom ko jab kay woh unn kay pass aayen, darayen takay woh darr jayen
Aey eman walo! unn kuffaar say laro jo tumharay aas pass hain aur unn ko tumharay andar sakhti pana chahaiye. Aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah Taalaa muttaqi logon kay sath hai

Aur jab koi surat nazil ki jati hai to baaz munafiqeen kehtay hain kay uss surat ney tum mein say kiss kay eman ko ziyadah kiya hai, so jo log eman walay hain uss surat ney unn kay eman ko ziyadah kiya hai aur woh khush horahey hain
Aur jin kay dilon mein rog hai uss surat ney unn mein unn ki gandagi kay sath aur gandagi barha di aur woh halat kufur hi mein marr gaye
Aur kiya unn ko nahi dikhlaee deta kay yeh log her saal aik baar ya do baar kissi na kissi aafat mein phanstay rehtay hain phir bhi na tauba kertay aur na naseehat qabool kertay hain

Aur jab koi surat nazil ki jati hai to aik doosray ko dekhney lagtay hain kay tum ko koi dekhta to nahi phir chal detay hain Allah Taalaa ney unn ka dil pher diya hai uss wajah say kay woh bey samajh log hain

Tumharay pass aik aisay payghumbar tashreef laye hain jo tumhari jinss say hain jin ko tumhari mazarrat ki baat nihayat giran guzarti hai jo tumhari manfa’at kay baray khuwahish mand rehtay hain eman walon kay sath baray hi shafiq aur meharban hain
Phir agar roo gardaani keren to aap keh dijiye kay meray liye Allah kafi hai, uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi. Mein ney ussi per bharosa kiya aur woh baray arsh ka malik hai
